name: Doki Doki Literature Club Foreign Relations Act 1
source:
This mod puts you in the shoes of a transfer student coming to Japan. Here, you will join the Literature Club and meet with its lovely members. You have one year before you leave Japan and return home, but could a special someone you meet make you stay there longer? Or perhaps, could you take that special someone home with you?

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/1e6xj18/foreign_relations_act_1_release/]Reddit[/url]]
